hotspots.label: THE PROTAGONIST
hotspots.detail: She steps out of the mist — the woman the whole town is watching.

sections.heading: Name
sections.text: Rose Loomis — played by Marilyn Monroe

sections.heading: Role
sections.text: The femme fatale of Niagara Falls, 1953

sections.heading: Quote
sections.text: "There's only two things in this world I'm afraid of — and one of them is this town."

hotspots.label: THE WHITE LOOK
hotspots.detail: White on white — Technicolor pushed past its comfort zone.

sections.heading: Costume
sections.text: Ivory dress, wide brim hat — a silhouette cut for the falls.

sections.heading: Lighting
sections.text: Backlit haze + hard key light: the classic noir rim.

sections.heading: Color
sections.text: Terracotta + sage + sand — lifted from the Swiss reference poster.

hotspots.label: THE FALL
hotspots.detail: Niagara Falls — 3,160 tons of water per second, and one secret between them.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Niagara Falls, Ontario / New York — shot on location, 1953.
